headline: Kamdhenu Limited makes payment to Kamdhenu Ventures for warrant conversion
summary: Kamdhenu Limited disclosed a payment made to Kamdhenu Ventures Limited to convert 1,50,00,000 warrants into equity shares. This corporate action alters the equity structure between the two entities involved. Indian retail investors tracking these companies should note the equity dilution and capital movement. Such conversions affect shareholding patterns and future value distribution.
why_it_matters: Shareholding structure changes following warrant conversion.

headline: Kamdhenu Limited releases Q2 financial results
hook: Kamdhenu reports September quarter financial results
summary: Kamdhenu Limited has officially filed its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange. The filing provides the company's performance metrics for the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail investors can access the detailed balance sheet and profit and loss statement on the exchange portal.
why_it_matters: Quarterly performance data dictates stock price movement for retail holders.

headline: Kamdhenu reports nil physical share transfer requests under SEBI special window
hook: Zero activity during regulatory relief window
summary: Kamdhenu has reported receiving zero physical share transfer requests during the special window provided by SEBI. This procedural update reflects the ongoing transition away from physical shareholdings in listed companies. For the Indian retail investor, this indicates minimal remaining physical folio friction for the company.
why_it_matters: No physical share overhang remaining for the company.
